is one assertion type the executor understands. The table below is the single source of the assertion vocabulary: the plan validator accepts exactly these types, the generation prompt advertises exactly these shapes, and the executor dispatch implements them.  It is data, not behaviour: evalAssertions' switch stays the reference implementation of each type's semantics. A kind the executor does not implement fails the parity test in internal/exec; a kind missing from the validator or the prompt fails the parity tests in internal/plan

assembles the generation request. authzSurface is the rendered ownership inference
